answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity sit locked for several epochs and are forfeited if its attestations are later slashed. An attacker spinning up a grove of fake agents must keep every one doing real, graded work through the whole delay, paying full reasoning cost per identity with nothing spendable to recycle. The lock is a velvet glove for honest agents, who lose only time, but a falcon's talon for farms that bet on fast cash-out.
